scope: 16 new bespoke Skirts subcategory photographs with the shared atmosphere treatment. The existing parent Skirts campaign image is retained. All 17 Skirts pages use bespoke campaign hero imagery. Existing product photography and all other page content outside the campaign note are unchanged.
artDirection: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one bespoke wide photographic hero for the WOW Fashion women's Skirts collection website, matching its premium warm editorial campaign. Create ONE finished photograph, horizontal 16:9 landscape, ideally 1672 by 941 pixels. Authentic natural fashion photography, lifelike skin, refined lens quality, realistic fabric texture, anatomically correct hands and believable garment construction. Show one adult woman on the RIGHT side, centred near 77 percent of the image width. Frame her complete figure, entire head with comfortable space above, and shoes with space beneath. Clearly show the skirt's waistband, complete silhouette and full hem; tops must be neatly tucked so the skirt shape remains visible. The LEFT 55 percent is quiet low-contrast warm pale limestone or plaster, unobstructed and ready for dark website headlines. Architecture, foliage and props stay mostly at the far right. Warm cream and pale stone surroundings, gentle flattering light, natural posture and realistic fabric movement. No text, letters, typography, logos, watermarks, UI, product labels, graphic gradients, smoke or artificial fog. The website adds its animated bottom blend later. Make this an original fashion campaign in a real setting, not an isolated catalogue cutout. Specific garment and scene:

assets.subject: An adult Black woman with loose natural curls wearing a soft sage-green cotton midi skirt with a comfortable gathered waistband, gentle A-line shape and easy mid-calf hem. A plain ivory short-sleeve cotton tee is tucked at the waist and white minimal trainers complete the outfit. She takes an unhurried step beside a pale limestone café terrace, natural cotton folds and relaxed everyday styling, the complete skirt and shoes visible.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman wearing a sage casual midi skirt on a limestone café terrace

assets.subject: An adult East Asian woman with a softly waved dark bob wearing a chestnut-brown corduroy skirt with a visible fine ribbed texture, a neat button front, a defined waistband and a gently flared knee-length hem. An ivory fine-knit crewneck sweater is tucked in, simple dark brown loafers. She stands naturally beside a pale plaster townhouse entrance in soft autumn light, realistic corduroy pile and entire skirt silhouette clearly shown.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a chestnut corduroy skirt outside a pale plaster townhouse

assets.subject: An adult woman with olive skin and loose chestnut waves wearing an authentic medium-blue denim midi skirt with a neat high waistband, front patch pockets, fine contrast stitching and a straight gently flared silhouette ending at mid-calf. A small practical front walking split begins below the knee. A white cotton shirt with elbow-length rolled sleeves is tucked in, tan flat sandals. She stands in a pale limestone courtyard in warm morning light, whole denim skirt and hem visible.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman wearing a blue denim midi skirt in a limestone courtyard

assets.subject: An adult South Asian woman with long loosely tied dark hair wearing a flowing bohemian tiered maxi skirt in an expressive small botanical print of terracotta, muted navy and cream. The skirt has a comfortable defined waistband, softly gathered tiers and an ankle-length hem with graceful natural movement. A simple modest ivory short-sleeve blouse is tucked in, tan flat sandals. Contemporary relaxed fashion with no costume or ethnic props. She walks lightly beside a pale plaster garden wall, complete long silhouette visible.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a flowing botanical tiered maxi skirt beside a pale garden wall

assets.subject: An adult Black woman in her thirties with a sleek shoulder-length bob wearing a camel tailored midi skirt with an unmistakably high structured waistband at the natural waist, a narrow matching belt, gentle front shaping and an elegant A-line silhouette ending just below the knee. assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman wearing a navy knee-length skirt on a limestone café terrace

assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a black leather-look skirt beside a pale stone restaurant entrance

assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a flowing burgundy long skirt beneath a limestone arcade
